title: biosig-zarr format version 3: time array metadata document
description: The zarr.json of the time array of a timestamped group in a format version 3 store, transcribed from spec/index.md on the branch draft/3.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two documents, such as the chunk length of time and of values and the group's chunk_samples, and the rules on the values (finite, not decreasing), are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Timestamped groups: a timestamped group holds the array time, float64, shape [n_samples], sharded.

node_type.$comment: Timestamped groups: time is an array.

data_type.$comment: Timestamped groups: time holds seconds on the recording timeline, as float64.

codecs.$comment: Timestamped groups: time is chunked with the sharding_indexed codec, with the inner codec chain and shard index of level 0.

attributes.$comment: Timestamped groups: the attributes of time are kind, unit, and derivation, all REQUIRED.
